notes: «قالا حدثنا حرب» : the two branches meet at Harb; the names after him are written once, so they form the shared tail
«حدثني رجل، من أهل المدينة» : an unnamed transmitter in his place (rule 8); «عن أبيه» is a bare relation
«- يعني ابن شداد -» is an editor's gloss: left out; «زاد هارون» is a wording addition: left out
